Apply here (but you should probably read this whole post first) An agent system is a system (that usually takes the form of a company) where agentic AI elements interact and compose an integrated whole. We’re interested in companies that have been newly designed assuming agentic AI as a core tenet. Companies built as agent systems take many of the most powerful properties of machine intelligence and embody them at the systemic level: Perception and Memory: Synthesize context from multiple sources and maintain memory across interactions Autonomous Planning: Independently develop multi-step strategies toward abstract goals End-to-end Execution: Complete entire workflows without human intervention, using whatever tools necessary Adaptability and Self Evaluation: Assess its own performance and adjust course A big “canary in the coal mine”-like signal that the era of Agent Systems is worth exploring comes from the world of agentic coding. Apply to AI Camp 5.14.2026 Meet the Spring 2026 Camp Cohort: Agent Systems Jordan Crook The world is changing fast. SaaS is shrinking in breadth as a small number of winners get much more depth. Forward-deployed engineering and AI-native services businesses are appealing after venture had written that posture off for the last twenty years. Prosumer tools are being overtaken by software that is radically more flexible and personalized. And consumer is staring down its first true renaissance in more than a decade. Underneath all of it: agents are quietly, inevitably becoming a core interface for how we work, live, and play. We planted a flag in this in October of 2025 — pre-OpenAI/OpenClaw, pre-run on Mac Minis, pre-Hermes-everything. We turned our focus toward Agent Systems and got to work. That work has two parts.
